note: Run boundaries as one tidy map (tools/boundaries): built from the Vicmap property-line boundaries stretched to the streets the trucks drive, then cleaned so that edges are straight and, wherever two runs meet - of the same stream or not - they use the very same line. Thin road stubs with no houses, overlaps and gaps are gone; a corner is only ever removed where no house would change run. Keys are stream#day#week#run (Garbage has no week).
